captions.detailed: A miniature stone-colored masonry bell tower with a dark grey pyramidal roof. The upper belfry stage features four corner pillars sheltering a central golden bell suspended from a black headstock. Near the base of the tower, a small black pulley wheel is mounted on a short axle pin. The bell is designed to swing via a revolute joint, while the base pulley wheel rotates independently on a continuous joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a masonry bell tower with an articulated swinging bell and a separate rope-guide pulley wheel at the base. The tower should have a square stone-colored body, a dark roof, a golden bell on a revolute joint, and a small black pulley wheel on a continuous joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base tower using a series of stacked Box primitives for the foundation, main shaft, belfry floor, and four corner pillars, capped with a pyramidal roof. The swinging bell is modeled as a conical or cylindrical assembly attached to a horizontal axle pin, connected to the tower via a revolute articulation. The separate rope-guide pulley is constructed from a small cylinder and wheel geometry, attached near the base of the tower via an independent continuous articulation.
